f.t: One in three internationally educated nurses ‘never been promoted’ in UK
f.x: More than a third (34%) of internationally educated nurses and midwives have never been promoted, including one in five (21%) of those with at least 10 years’ experience in the UK, a survey has revealed.

f.t: Patient experience and engagement during acute non-invasive ventilation
f.x: Aim: To explore patients’ experiences of acute non-invasive ventilation (NIV) and examine the role of patient engagement in treatment acceptance and tolerance. Methods: A descriptive qualitative design was employed using semistructured interviews with five patients who had recently received acute NIV.

f.t: SNOMED CT UK Drug Extension: grouper concepts being removed, supplier survey closes 20 November 2026
f.x: NHS England is removing the five grouper concepts from the SNOMED CT UK Drug Extension in Phase 2 of its alignment to the SNOMED International national drug extension model, scheduled for Quarter 4 2026, and replacing them with Refsets.

f.t: Ombudsman report: Strengthening NHS wheelchair services
f.x: The Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman reports a significant rise in complaints about NHS wheelchair services over five years and sets out commissioning recommendations.
